mutations_proposed.rationale: Lower threshold to increase trade frequency from stagnation, capture more opportunities while Sharpe is strong enough to absorb slightly weaker signals
Extend take profit to ride winners longer given high Sharpe indicates good signal quality, increase yield per trade beyond current modest 0.175 USDC
Widen trailing stop to reduce premature exits on healthy pullbacks, allow trends to develop more fully before locking in profits
